items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: He got me a few record dates on his label, Roost label.

ctx.x: I called -- from the airport I called Teddy Rerg and told him that I was at La Guardia Airport and on my way to Philadelphia until my probation was up and then I'd be on into New York. He said, "Man, don't go to Philadelphia." He said, "They'll arrest you if you spit on the ground, and they have the blue law there, too, that you can't work on Sundays." He said, "You better come on into town. I'll send Ned out there." Well, Ned was Erroll Garner's valet, but he was working for Teddy now, at this time. So Ned shows…

He said, "I noticed when I got up the phone was off the hook." He didn't remember even talking to me, even answering the phone. So I got together with him. He got me a few record dates on his label, Roost label. And he was recording -- like we were the house musicians. Cozy Cole and Sanford Gold Goal, a piano player. And --
